task.title: Register storage/backup reports and operations sampling
task.input: job-foundation, a controlled server script, existing backup metadata and the section 10 report contract
task.output: ops-sources: ops-sample, POST /api/internal/ops-report and a read-only report script
task.accept: 1) A controlled deploy script makes real POST /api/internal/ops-report with strict Bearer authentication and field allowlists. Only space counts and backup completion/verification metadata are allowed; reject arbitrary paths and contents. The same source+measuredAt and payload is idempotent, a different payload at the same time returns 409, and an older time cannot replace new values. Unverifiable sources are not_connected. Direct SALES/EDITOR GET stats requests for STORAGE/BACKUP return 403 without counts, and an admin session cannot replace report Bearer authentication (E-65, E-66). 2) Register ops-sample in registry, composition and actual cron every 15 minutes; it runs on schedule after restart. Stats reads real measuredAt/lastSucceededAt; stopping reports preserves original time/stale values, and no restore verification means no recoverable claim. Auxiliary failure does not block core statistics (E-64, E-67).
